question: Which district's 2025 budget works out higher per school pupil, Harrowfield or Tarnvale, and by how many thousand tenge per pupil?
answer:
Tarnvale's budget works out higher by 0.1 thousand tenge per pupil.

ANSWER: Tarnvale | 0.1

matches.title: Harrowfield district profile (2025)
matches.text: Founded in 1862 on the Harrow, Harrowfield covers 1,388.5 square kilometres. Its budget for 2025 was set at 16,021.7 million tenge. Household water use in 2025 came to 7,146 megalitres. There are 36 schools in the district, attended by 13,904 pupils in 2025/26. The 2025 census recorded 90,212 residents; the 2020 census had recorded 83,609. The district's paved road network is 1,037.2 km long.

matches.title: Ossbridge district profile (2025)
matches.text: Founded in 1871 on the Oss, Ossbridge covers 1,284.6 square kilometres. Its budget for 2025 was set at 9,284.5 million tenge. Household water use in 2025 came to 3,862 megalitres. There are 21 schools in the district, attended by 7,413 pupils in 2025/26. The 2025 census recorded 52,904 residents; the 2020 census had recorded 48,317. The district's paved road network is 612.4 km long.

matches.title: Ossford district profile (2025)
matches.text: Ossford has 14 schools, which enrolled 4,390 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1903, stretches along the Oss over 846.2 square kilometres and keeps 388.9 km of paved road. Census population: 31,560 in 2020 and 30,982 in 2025. Households used 2,418 megalitres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 5,117.8 million tenge.

matches.title: Tarnvale district profile (2025)
matches.text: Tarnvale lies on the Tarn and was founded in 1854. The 2025 census counted 71,388 residents, up from 67,214 at the 2020 census, on an area of 2,106.9 square kilometres. Households used 5,207 megalitres of water in 2025.

matches.title: Kelmarsh district profile (2025)
